# MetFilm School

> > MetFilm School is a leading film, television, and digital media education institution with campuses in London, Berlin, Leeds, and Manchester, offering BA and MA degrees in filmmaking, directing, producing, and acting.

MetFilm School provides practical film education with strong industry connections to BAFTA, Netflix, BBC, and Channel 4. The school emphasizes hands-on training, sustainability initiatives, and career development through partnerships with major production companies like ProVision, Procam, and Take 2.
